lamps.steady: Engine fault that may increase emission levels. Contact a TATA MOTORS Authorised Service Centre.
Fault in the Engine Management System. Contact a TATA MOTORS Authorised Service Centre.
Problem with key or system. Contact a TATA MOTORS Authorised Service Centre.
lamps.flashing: Vehicle is immobilized because the original key is not inserted.

lamps.steady: Excess water in the fuel filter. Drain it immediately at a service centre to avoid damage.
Glow plugs are active for engine preheating. Start the engine only after this light turns off.

lamps.flashing: Indicates the direction of the turn signal. Blinks along with a buzzer.

lamps.steady: High beam headlights are switched on or flashed.
Insufficient oil pressure. Stop safely, switch off engine, check oil, and contact TATA MOTORS assistance.
Malfunction in the charging system. Contact a TATA MOTORS Authorised Service Centre.

lamps.lamp: Park Brake / Brake Fluid Low / ABS Fault / EBD Fault
lamps.steady: Parking brake is on, brake fluid is low, or there is an ABS/EBD system fault.
Seat belt is not fastened. An alarm sounds if vehicle speed exceeds 25 kmph.
Malfunction in the airbag (SRS) system. Contact a TATA MOTORS Authorised Service Centre immediately.
Fault in the Electric Power Assisted Steering. Contact a TATA MOTORS Authorised Service Centre immediately.
Engine coolant temperature is low. Turns off when engine temperature reaches normal levels.
Engine coolant temperature is very high. Stop engine and allow it to cool.
lamps.flashing: Engine temperature is extremely high. Stop engine, cool down, and contact service centre.

lamps.steady: ABS malfunction. Normal braking remains operational without ABS assistance. Contact service centre immediately.
Fuel level is low. Refill the tank as soon as possible.
lamps.flashing: Fault in the fuel system. Contact a TATA MOTORS Authorised Service Centre immediately.

lamps.steady: Economy drive mode is active for better fuel mileage.
